req.title: PUT rejects payload ID mismatch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when the playerId in the path does not match the id in the PUT body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} must return HTTP 400 when the squad_number in the path does not match the squad_number in the request body. The route handler checks `if player_model.squad_number != squad_number` and raises HTTPException(400). Tests must cover: (1) positive — matching IDs yield non-400 response; (2) negative — mismatched IDs yield exactly 400; (3) boundary — squad_number differing by exactly ±1 from path value triggers 400. Additional cases cover the decision table (both sides of the equality check) and mutation resilience (exact status code assertions, both operand paths of the != comparison).

tests.name: test_put_matching_squad_number_does_not_return_400
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (Lionel Messi, pre-loaded fixture)
Request body squad_number matches path parameter squad_number=10
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with body containing squad_number=10
expected: HTTP response status code is NOT 400
HTTP response status code is 204 (no content on successful update path) or 500 (db bug in fixture), but never 400
trace: R-PLAYER-011: mismatch triggers 400; match must NOT trigger 400
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_matching_squad_number_does_not_return_400():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Lionel",
        "middleName": "Andres",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code != 400

test_put_matching_squad_number_does_not_return_400()
